description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract base class for HTTP endpoints in the Eclipse Hono project. It provides utility methods for extracting JSON payloads, handling HTTP responses, event bus communication, CORS configuration, and parameter extraction.

classes.name: AbstractHttpEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for HTTP-based Hono endpoints, providing common functionality such as request validation, parameter extraction, response handling, event bus messaging, and CORS configuration.

methods.name: extractRequiredJson
methods.description: Checks for 'application/json' Content-Type, parses the request body as JSON, and stores it in the routing context.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts the JSON payload from the routing context as a JSON object.

methods.name: extractOptionalJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON payload if present; if no body, sets empty JSON object.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonArrayPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON array payload from the request body.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseHandler
methods.description: Creates a response handler that sends JSON responses with appropriate HTTP status and body.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Sends a message to the event bus and processes the response via provided handler.

methods.name: getTenantParam
methods.description: Retrieves tenant ID from request parameters.

methods.name: getDeviceIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves device ID from request parameters.

methods.name: extractIfMatchVersionParam
methods.description: Extracts the 'If-Match' header value for concurrency control.

methods.name: createDefaultCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates a CORS handler allowing common methods from specified origin.

methods.name: createCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates a CORS handler allowing specified HTTP methods from a given origin.
